Label-Efficient Roof Mapping with Honest Spatial Validation.** Classify roof material (metal, thatch, concrete tile) in synthetic aerial tiles from ten labelled villages and a pool of unlabelled tiles, quantify how much random splits overstate accuracy, compare supervised, patch-dictionary and normalised features across label budgets, and defend which claims the evidence supports.
